title: Reproduce: Association Between Atopic Dermatitis, Asthma, and Serum Lipids: A UK Biobank Based Observational Study and Mendelian Randomization Analysis.
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the source paper PMID 35265637 using its declared data sources: UK Biobank and OpenGWAS summary statistics?
task: Reconstruct a documented, bounded analysis from PMID 35265637 using UK Biobank and OpenGWAS summary statistics. Report the exact scope and missing source components. A UK Biobank-only analysis cannot stand in for absent sources. Primary endpoint: associations between atopic dermatitis, asthma, and serum lipid traits.
endpoint: associations between atopic dermatitis, asthma, and serum lipid traits
rediscovery_target: Reconstruct the source study analysis for: associations between atopic dermatitis, asthma, and serum lipid traits. Declare any deviations or missing modules.
new_discovery_target: Perform one prespecified, data-supported sensitivity or subgroup analysis; distinguish it from source reproduction and report uncertainty.

data.name: UK Biobank and OpenGWAS summary statistics
data.description: Primary paper verification shows a UK Biobank observational analysis plus bidirectional Mendelian randomization using OpenGWAS sources, requiring two distinct estimand contracts.
